_meta.description: Acceptance criteria. YOU own these numbers - edit them here or in the dashboard, never in code. Spec section 07.
_meta.how_to_read: invariants have no tolerance and block unconditionally, baseline or not. thresholds are absolute bars, each declaring its own on_fail. regression is checked separately against the recorded baseline in sigma units.
_meta.advice: Set the threshold values AFTER the first 5-repeat baseline. Choosing them before you know whether the system scores 0.97 or 0.71 just produces a gate you immediately edit.
_meta.status: STARTING VALUES - not yet calibrated against a real baseline

leaked_url_count.why: A URL reached the answer without being on the allowlist. The guard failed - a different and worse problem than any metric regression.

fabricated_entity_rate.why: An invented employer, date or number reached the output.

prompt_leak_count.why: The system prompt was reproduced verbatim.

human_rating_min.why: No single answer may be actively harmful, whatever the mean says.

regression.why: A metric may not fall more than 2 sigma below the recorded baseline. min_absolute is a floor for the tolerance so that a metric with a near-zero sigma does not gate on noise smaller than the measurement can resolve.
